title: Unit – 1 : Session – 9 : SLO – 2  |  Operating System Services — Crossword
sections: 1. COMMUNICATION (IPC) — allows processes to exchange data through message passing or shared memory.
2. PROTECTION — prevents unauthorized access to programs, data or devices by enforcing security rules.
3. PROGRAM EXECUTION — the OS loads and runs user applications by managing CPU and memory.
4. ERROR DETECTION — identifies and handles hardware/software problems to maintain stability.
9. ACCOUNTING — tracks how resources are used, helping with billing, auditing or statistics.
11. I/O OPERATIONS — the OS handles input from keyboards and output to screens or printers.
12. FILE MANIPULATION (FILE SYSTEM) — organizes and stores data in files and directories.
13. RESOURCE ALLOCATION — distributes CPU, memory and I/O devices to programs as needed.
The letters in the bold rectangles spell: SERVICES (the worksheet theme is OS services).
